name: adHighCpu
notes: CPU burn in the ad service. Injection confirmed in run 1 (GetAds p50 4.4ms to 10.8ms); run 2 verified in run2.log.

name: adManualGc
notes: Injection did NOT fire: docker logs ad shows zero collections in this window (run2.log records ad-GC-lines=0), and it also failed to fire on the previous attempt. Kept in the set rather than dropped after seeing the result. A decline here is the demo doing nothing, not inquest missing a cause.

name: productCatalogFailure
notes: Fails GetProduct for one product id (OLJCESPC7Z). Could not fire at all before this run: the flag ships with a targeting rule whose branches are both 'off', which overrides defaultVariant. Error-rate case.

name: recommendationCacheFailure
notes: A cache that grows without bound, so the effect accumulates through the window rather than stepping. In run 1 the responsible operation reached rank 2 with score 1.60 against a 3.0 threshold — a near miss, not a blind spot.
